t: A credit card sized handheld game and name badge you can program.
steps: Buy the PyBadge from Adafruit for about 35 US dollars or from a reseller such as The Pi Hut.
Get a micro-USB data cable to connect it to your computer.
Open MakeCode Arcade in your web browser.
Build a simple sprite game from the starter tutorials.
Download the game and drag the file onto the badge drive.
Play your game and tweak it with new blocks.
Add an optional small battery to take it on the go.
Try CircuitPython next with the Mu editor and the Adafruit Learn guide.
meta: Wild Open. From $34.95. A few stores.
